title: Diagnostics of cognitive failures in multi-agent expert systems using dynamic evaluation protocols and subsequent mutation of the processing context

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a 'Gendered Language Agent' that identifies and neutralizes gender-coded words in job descriptions. The evaluation compares the agent's extracted sentences and suggested rewrites against an expert-annotated 'golden dataset' using BERTScore and a rubric-based LLM Agent Judge to measure stylistic alignment and extraction fidelity.

Evaluating a 'Neuro-diversity Agent' designed to make job descriptions accessible to neuro-divergent applicants (e.g., by minimizing figurative language). The methodology measures the agent's sentence extraction accuracy (precision/recall) and behavioral alignment (tone, stylistic fidelity) with expert annotations using BERTScore and a multi-facet LLM Agent Judge.
